prompt: Was the person who served as president of the Scottish National Party from 1987 to 2005 alive when the party was founded?
answer: Yes. Winnie Ewing was born on 10 July 1929, and the Scottish National Party was founded on 7 April 1934. She was therefore alive and about four years old when the party was founded.
